name: The Science of Learning
description: Evidence-based techniques for mastering complex topics, long-term retention, and deliberate practice.

topics.title: Spaced Repetition & Active Retrieval
topics.notes: Ebbinghaus forgetting curve, Leitner system, active recall testing effect, and interval scheduling.
topics.why_it_matters: Active retrieval produces significantly higher long-term retention compared to passive rereading or highlighting.

topics.title: Cognitive Load Theory in Knowledge Acquisition
topics.notes: Intrinsic, extraneous, and germane cognitive load; working memory limitations; and chunking strategies.
topics.why_it_matters: Helps learners and educators structure information so working memory is not overwhelmed.
